claim: In the matching retail DLL, SaveData.IsDLCInstalled (0x060051C9) is an instance one-DLCEnum-parameter Boolean method with exact signature blob 2001021185c8 and an exact 45-byte body. It first calls static DLCChecker.IsOwner(dlc) at token 0x06001033; a false result returns false. It then reads this.dlcVersion[dlc] from SaveData.dlcVersion (0x0400650C, Int32[]); a zero element returns false. If the raw dlc argument is not 3, the method returns true. When raw dlc is 3, it recursively calls this.IsDLCInstalled(raw 2) and returns that result. FACT-0117 pins the already-canonical caller at ThemeMusicInfo.CheckValidationDLC IL+0x0027, passing its raw loop index.
